name: Angiogenesis
desc: A capillary bed under a fluorescence microangiogram, perpetually sprouting. Trunks branch across the field into ever-finer capillaries that meander and anastomose into loops, every vessel a lumen you can see the blood move through -- bright cells stream down each one on a pulsatile heartbeat. The bed is never finished: distal capillaries continuously sprout and regress, fading in and out on their own slow phases, and every terminal carries a migrating tip cell throwing out wiggling filopodia. Flow, pulse and remodelling all run on incommensurate rates so nothing converges. Offered as red microangiography fluorescence, India-ink perfusion, a metallic corrosion cast, or a false-colour Doppler velocity map.

scale.doc: magnification into the bed - vessels swell, guaranteed visible change

speed.doc: flow speed, heartbeat and remodelling rate

density.doc: how richly the vascular tree branches and how many cells flow

flow.doc: blood flow rate and pulsatility through the lumens

seed.doc: deterministic - re-grows the entire vascular tree and its remodelling phases
